landing.title: Get a resume ready for the parser — then download it and leave.
landing.lead: Applicant tracking systems stumble on columns, tables, and inconsistent headings. This tool checks an existing CV or builds one from your own words, using standard section names a parser can actually read.
landing.how1Body: Upload a PDF or DOCX to correct, or type each section yourself.
landing.how2Body: Nothing is sent until you accept the privacy terms. The file lives in memory for that request only.
landing.how3Body: Spelling, date formats, heading consistency, and ATS blockers — then download a cleaner file.
landing.how4Body: Export DOCX (best for ATS) or PDF. We keep no copy.
landing.ats1: Single column. No tables, text boxes, or multi-column layouts.
landing.ats2: Standard headings: Summary, Skills, Experience, Education.
landing.ats3: Contact details in the body, not a header or footer graphic.
landing.ats4: Consistent dates and bullet style throughout.
landing.ats5: Your facts only — no invented jobs, degrees, or dates.
landing.privacyTitle: We do not store your resume
landing.privacy1: There are no accounts and no history. Your file is processed in memory for that request, then discarded. Closing the tab ends the session. We cannot recover it. We keep a salted IP hash for about an hour only to enforce the free-use cap.
landing.privacy2: Rewrites use GPT-OSS 120B via Groq — an open-weight public model. Groq does not train on API inputs.
landing.limits1: 3 AI checks per hour per person. Downloads do not count.
landing.limits2: The free model budget is shared. The tool may pause for everyone if it is used up — try again later.
landing.limits3: Uploads over 3 MB are rejected. Long CVs are shortened; later pages may be ignored.
landing.cardAnalyzeBody: Upload what you have. Get spelling, format, and parser issues, then download a cleaned version.
landing.cardAssembleBody: Paste bio, skills, jobs, and education in plain text. We recommend ATS-structured wording without inventing facts.

consent.label: I understand my resume is sent to our processor and an open-weight GPT-OSS model on Groq for this request only, is not stored, and is not used to train models.
consent.noAccounts: No accounts. Closing this tab discards everything.
consent.noRecover: We cannot recover a lost session.
consent.noTrain: Groq does not train on API data.

analyze.title: Guided corrections
analyze.lead: Upload a PDF or DOCX. We parse it in memory, list issues, and let you download a cleaner file. Nothing is saved.
analyze.cardDesc: The checkbox is required before a file can leave your browser.
analyze.issuesDesc: Accept, edit, or download. We do not invent employers, dates, or degrees.
analyze.resultDesc: This is what will be in the download — not the raw preview above.

assemble.title: Build from your own words
assemble.lead: Write each section in plain language. We recommend ATS headings and phrasing without adding employers, dates, or degrees you did not provide.
assemble.cardDesc: Your text is sent only after you accept the terms below.
assemble.name: Name
assemble.experienceHint: One role or bullet per line
assemble.resultDesc: ATS-structured wording from your text. Proper nouns are left as you wrote them.

limits.fairUse: 3 AI checks per hour per person. Downloads do not count.
limits.shared: The free model budget is shared. The tool may pause for everyone if it is used up.
limits.truncateFile: Long CVs are shortened; later pages may be ignored.
limits.truncatePaste: Very long pasted text is also shortened before the model sees it.
